 """py.test tests for addbook"""
+import pytest
 import web
 from .. import addbook
 from openlibrary import accounts
 from openlibrary.mocks.mock_infobase import MockSite
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    'author_fields',
+    [{}, {'author_key': ['OL1A']}, {'author_name': ['Author One']}],
+)
+def test_make_work_without_matching_author_fields(author_fields):
+    doc = {'title': 'A title', **author_fields}
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert isinstance(work, web.Storage)
+    assert work.title == 'A title'
+    assert work.authors == []
+    assert work.cover_url == '/images/icons/avatar_book-sm.png'
+    assert work.ia == []
+    assert work.first_publish_year is None
+    for field, value in author_fields.items():
+        assert work[field] == value
+
+
+def test_make_work_preserves_metadata_and_creates_authors(monkeypatch):
+    class Site:
+        def new(self, key, data):
+            return {'path': key, **data}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web.ctx, 'site', Site(), raising=False)
+    doc = {
+        'title': 'A title',
+        'author_key': ['OL1A'],
+        'author_name': ['Author One'],
+        'cover_url': '/covers/1.jpg',
+        'ia': ['item1'],
+        'first_publish_year': 2000,
+    }
+
+    work = addbook.make_work(doc)
+
+    assert work.authors == [
+        {
+            'path': '/authors/OL1A',
+            'key': '/authors/OL1A',
+            'type': {'key': '/type/author'},
+            'name': 'Author One',
+        }
+    ]
+    assert work.cover_url == '/covers/1.jpg'
+    assert work.ia == ['item1']
+    assert work.first_publish_year == 2000
+    assert work.title == 'A title'
+
+
 def strip_nones(d):
     return {k: v for k, v in d.items() if v is not None}
